statements.postgres: A criss-cross merge has two equal best ancestors, of which Dolt takes the one with the greater commit address, where Doltgres takes the first it reaches so the choice does not change with commit times
statements.sql:
SELECT CASE
  WHEN dolt_merge_base('C', 'D') = dolt_hashof('A') THEN CONCAT('LCA', '|', 'a1')
  WHEN dolt_merge_base('C', 'D') = dolt_hashof('B') THEN CONCAT('LCA', '|', 'b1')
  ELSE CONCAT('LCA', '|', 'OTHER')
END
